title: Arbitrage Profit Calculator
explanation: Calculate the risk-free profit from arbitrage trading between two markets with differing prices.

cells:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Define arbitrage parameters
price_a = 30  # price at Market A
price_b = 40  # price at Market B
profit_per_kg = 10  # arbitrage profit per kilogram
kg_traded = 100  # kilograms traded

# Calculate total profit
total_profit = profit_per_kg * kg_traded

# Plot the profit per kilogram and total
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
plt.plot([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], [profit_per_kg] * 5, marker='o', linestyle='-', label='Profit per kg')
plt.plot([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], [total_profit] * 5, marker='s', linestyle='--', label='Total Profit')
plt.title('Arbitrage Profit Calculation')
plt.xlabel('Time Step')
plt.ylabel('Profit ($)')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()
